title: RC Vehicles
description: "Remote-control cars and planes with a bindable remote and first-person camera"
body:
# RC Vehicles

RC Vehicles adds remote-control vehicles to Minecraft — drive cars and fly planes, either by riding them or controlling them from a distance with a handheld remote.

## Vehicles

**RC Car** — A fully drivable custom vehicle. Hop in and drive it directly, or bind a remote and control it from afar. It climbs blocks and handles uneven terrain.

**RC Plane** — Takes to the skies with realistic flight physics: build up airspeed to stay airborne, pitch up to climb and down to dive. Slow down too much and it'll stall, just like the real thing.

## The Remote

Craft an **RC Remote**, then right-click any vehicle while holding it to bind to that vehicle. Once bound, you can drive or fly it from a distance — perfect for sending a car around a corner or flying a plane overhead.

Press **V** while holding the remote to switch to a first-person camera mounted on your vehicle, so you can see exactly where it's going.

## Controls

- **Right-click** a vehicle with the remote to bind to it
- **W** — throttle / accelerate
- **S** — brake / reverse
- **A / D** — turn left / right
- **Space** — climb (plane)
- **Shift** — dive (plane)
- **V** — toggle first-person camera

## Crafting

Both vehicles and the remote are crafted with **iron and redstone**, so you can build them in survival.

## Requirements

- **Fabric Loader** + **Fabric API**
- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Must be installed on **both the client and the server**

---

*This is an early alpha release — expect rough edges and more vehicles to come!*
